Path Forward: The present research project suggests that the concept has promise from a technical and technoeconomic perspective. The next step is construction of a pilot system to validate the modeling and assess some of the engineering challenges identified by this project. In particular, the effect of ancillary Si deposits must be understood, and if necessary, controlled in order to enable the long deposition runs required to grow thick feed boules. Various ideas to hold and translate the feed rod must be developed and tested in a pilot environment. Parallel efforts to develop float zone crystallization of larger boules are also necessary to enable this technology. The economics of the technology are particularly sensitive to the deposition rate of Si, and so, research into methods that can unlock faster growth rates for Si, perhaps exploring catalysts or alternative precursors, would be particularly important. Growth of pseudo-square boules would also improve economics by eliminating wafering losses and should be studied.
